title: How should duplicates match?
intro: We group similar armor rolls so you can pick a keeper and tag the rest in DIM. You can change this anytime in Settings.
noTieredArmor: No tiered armor in scope at your minimum tier
tieredArmorFootnote: Only in-game tiered gear (T1–T5) is included. Lower the minimum tier in Settings if needed.
customizeIntro: Tighten or loosen what counts as a duplicate. Presets in Settings set these in one click.

impact.none: No duplicate groups found for {{class}} at your current tier.
